name: Baron Marinous
objectiveText: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore . Clouded Water Globe (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: Kill nagas and collect [b]20[/b] [item=279276]. No prior quests are required. Use the fragments at [object=669236] at around [b]59, 22[/b][i] (same structure type as BFD entrance)[/i]. This spawns an elite elemental named [npc=270294]. They can be soloed by going behind the pillars as he's about to cast, and then coming out to use your ranged attacks. Turn in to [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=3616/onu#map]Onu[/url] at the Grove of Ancients down south and enjoy the rewards.

Collect [b]20[/b] [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=279276/mathystral-amulet-fragment]Mathystral Amulet Fragment[/url] and combine them at the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=669236/fathom-stone]Fathom Stone[/url] at the bottom of the spiral staircase at 59:23 in the Ruins of Mathystra. Use the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=279277/mathystral-amulet]Mathystral Amulet[/url] immediately to summon [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=270294/baron-marinous]Baron Marinous[/url], a level 21 gold elite. The elite drops the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=279275/clouded-water-globe]Clouded Water Globe[/url] which starts the quest [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=98028/baron-marinous]Baron Marinous[/url] that you can turn in to [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=3616/onu]Onu[/url] in the Grove of the Ancients for one of two blue items: [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=281291/mathystra-channeling-orb]Mathystra Channeling Orb[/url] (Off-hand, +5 Int, +3 Stam) or [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=281292/onus-patience]Onu's Patience[/url] (Off-hand, +3 Stam, +5 Spirit).
[b][i]Pro Tip![/i] - The fragments are [u]unique[/u] but they are not [u]soulbound![/u] Group up and have one person collect all of the fragments.[/b] Only one person needs to summon him for everyone to get the quest item. Plus, grouping makes the killing go by faster. [i]Good luck, and happy hunting![/i] [small]:)[/small]
